parsed.explanation: State-directed targeting is the dominant exposure. In 2017 police detained at least 100 people in capital raids, with beatings, forced medical examinations, blackmail, rape threats and electric shocks documented; at least 60 were imprisoned or fined. That operation is dated, but a July 2023 police raid on a private queer party involving forced medical examinations, physical/sexual harassment and outing threats shows the practice did not end. A March 2024 murder of a trans woman received an inadequate police investigation, and accountability for 2017 was pursued externally, culminating in a 2024 regional court ruling. There is no prohibition of discrimination, media are documented as 77% hateful/biased in 2023, and state-affiliated media aired discriminatory speech. No trans-specific border, facility or custody rule is documented, and no violence denominator is given, so I do not infer a murder rate. The documented pattern of police coercion with impunity places this in high risk, below regular presentation-offence imprisonment and above unremedied service exclusion.
